_meta.title: TriageWiseProdrome — dual-score rendering cases (req R2)
_meta.validates: TriageService._render_dual_score(severity, explanation) -> (dual_score_line, xai_line). The disagreement display: score_line (both modes) + xai_line (delta prose, xai only).
_meta.nature: Pure-function. Feed system_ESI + clinician_ESI + factor_breakdown; assert the two returned strings exactly.
conventions: ESI numbers are INVERTED: lower number = MORE acute (ESI-1 most acute).
system MORE acute (system_num < clinician_num) OR equal -> xai_line names the minimal-crossing delta driver set.
clinician MORE acute (system_num > clinician_num) -> xai_line = 'Your {clinician_ESI} takes precedence.' (no drivers).
delta set: sort drivers by weight desc, accumulate until score >= ESI_THRESHOLDS[system_ESI]. Chief complaint renders patient_value; vitals render '{factor} {patient_value}'.
score_line always 'System suggests: {system}\nClinician score: {clinician}' when clinician present.

cases._why: System ESI-1 more acute than clinician ESI-2 (lower number = more acute). Shows delta prose naming the minimal-crossing driver set. Robert: chest pain(6)+SpO2(4)=10 >= thr 8, so top 2 drivers; HR and RR excluded.
